caption: The drawing consists of four rectangular panels arranged in a 2x2 grid on a light background. Each panel features a single, roughly sketched, reddish-brown humanoid or abstract figure with exaggerated limbs and other features. The figures are filled with a textured, solid reddish-brown color and are drawn against a background shaded with diagonal gray strokes. The upper left figure has two upward-pointing protrusions on its head, long arms, and spread fingers and toes. The upper right figure has a triangular or wing-like shape to its left side and ends in simple, three-pronged feet, with an oval head attached to a thin neck. The lower left figure is tall and armless with a rounded base, and it appears headless with small marks above where a head might be. The lower right figure is more compact and bent at the knees and elbows, with a rough circular shape for the head, rays or lines emanating from it, and distinct fingers and toes. Each panel’s reddish-brown figure is centered within its respective box, with the textured gray background filling the remaining space.
title: Petroglyph Design
